newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain child-sex ring victimised 85 - report.
newsitem.headline: Spain child-sex ring victimised 85 - report.

text.p: Investigators believe as many as 85 children were sexually abused by a pornography and prostitution ring broken up by Spanish police last month, a Barcelona newspaper reported on Tuesday.

La Vanguardia daily said authorities had more than doubled the list of victims after examining thousands of pornographic videos, pictures and computer diskettes seized during raids on the paedophile ring.
Barcelona police last month arrested 12 people for suspected involvement in the ring, which has been linked to other paedophile networks outside Spain.
The suspects included doctors, teachers, a local politician and the former head of a child recreation centre. Police have refused to release their names.
La Vanguardia said five suspects were being held pending trial and seven others had been charged and released on bail. The newspaper said the ring had operated for 10 years.

About 30 of the children identified had been interviewed by the judge in charge of the case. Some admitted they were forced to take part in photographic sessions, video recordings and were sexually abused.
Others said they were hired out as prostitutes for between 3,000 and 5,000 pesetas ($20-$30) in the flat of one of those arrested, the newspaper said.
Barcelona police declined comment on the newspaper report.
The investigation began last April. Police made their first arrests in June when they discovered a couple who had rented out their 10 year-old son as a prostitute at weekends for $200.
